videos.script: A model does not know where your answer ends. {{ends}} It knows what usually comes next. After one answer, that is often the next question. {{next}} So it answers, and then keeps going, writing a question nobody asked. {{runs}} A stop sequence is a piece of text that ends the loop the moment it appears. {{stop}} The model never sees it. The loop checks the output, and cuts. {{check}} In this lesson you watch toylm run past its answer, and stop it at the next question. {{toylm}} Then you choose stops badly on purpose: one that removes the cake from a menu, and one that fires inside a word. {{bad}} By the end you can pick a stop that marks the end, and never the middle. {{pick}}
